target.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, 'Fleet rollout ' || status AS text, 'rollout' AS tags FROM grafana_fleet_rollouts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, 'Edge artifact published: ' || kind AS text, 'artifact' AS tags FROM grafana_edge_artifacts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, kind ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at AS time, 'Cache purge ' || type AS text, 'purge' AS tags FROM grafana_cache_purges WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

SELECT created_at AS time, action AS text, 'settings' AS tags FROM grafana_audit_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (action LIKE 'settings.%' OR action LIKE 'platform.%') ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at AS time, 'Emergency mode on for ' || target_type AS text, 'emergency' AS tags FROM grafana_emergency_modes WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

description: Every traffic measure summed across all PoPs, then split by region, PoP, pool, protocol, IP version, country, and ASN.

panels.description: Requests per second by pool, from the 1-minute, hourly, or daily rollup.

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time, pop, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_1m WHERE interval_start >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 0 AND 172800 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY time, pop UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time, pop, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 172801 AND 34560000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY time, pop UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time, pop, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_daily WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 34560001 AND 10000000000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY time, pop) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Client networks sending the most requests. ASNs are kept in raw events only, so this covers at most 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(asn) AS asn_label, count() AS request_count FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND asn != 0 AND event_type = 'request' GROUP BY asn_label ORDER BY request_count DESC LIMIT 10

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT hostname, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 0 AND 34560000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) AND $__conditionalAll(hostname IN (${hostname:singlequote}), $hostname) GROUP BY hostname UNION ALL SELECT hostname, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_daily WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) BETWEEN 34560001 AND 10000000000 AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) AND $__conditionalAll(hostname IN (${hostname:singlequote}), $hostname) GROUP BY hostname) ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 10
